summary: Add coerceBoolOrComposite() so --text/--highlights/--summary on contents map true/false and JSON-object values to the correct wire types.
reason: The /contents endpoint's text/highlights/summary fields are bool|object polymorphic; the generated string flags sent 'true' as a literal string, which the API rejects with HTTP 400.
validated_outcome: contents --urls https://example.com --text true returns extracted text (was HTTP 400).
